Entries.Title: Pump Up the Healthy Love
Entries.Description: Do Hyun Joong, a fallen bodybuilding star, now manages a rundown 24-hour gym. Lee Mi Ran, fresh off a breakup, mistakes it for a nightclub and ends up humiliated. Hyun Joong offers to transform her life through intense training, but his brutal honesty drives her away. Still, his words hit a nerve. Can Hyun Joong change heartbroken Mi Ran's life and save the crumbling gym?

Episodes.Title: When Muscles Meet Meltdowns
Episodes.Description: Do Hyun Joong, a fallen bodybuilding star, now manages a rundown 24-hour gym. Lee Mi Ran, fresh off a breakup, mistakes it for a nightclub and ends up humiliated. Hyun Joong offers to transform her life through intense training, but his brutal honesty drives her away. Still, his words hit a nerve. Can Hyun Joong change heartbroken Mi Ran's life and save the crumbling gym?

Episodes.Title: Heartbreak Bootcamp
Episodes.Description: Mi-ran sets out on a gruelling fitness journey to win back her ex, and the entire gym gets caught up in her mission. Hyun-joong sees a spark of potential in her, pushing her even harder. But is it for her sake or the gym's survival? As every rep tests her spirit, Mi-ran must confront what she's really fighting for.

Episodes.Title: Mi Ran’s Training Crumbles
Episodes.Description: Mi Ran's intense training program falls apart and goes to waste after she breaks down in front of her ex-boyfriend. Despite achieving some results, including fitting into an undersized dress, Mi Ran quits the gym and demands a refund, leaving Hyun Joong frustrated. Meanwhile, Hyun Joong puts everything on the line to attract 120,000 new members to the gym, determined to turn the struggling gym around.

Episodes.Title: Pushed Too Far
Episodes.Description: Mi-ran struggles with harsh criticism from her visiting mother while Rosa faces pressure to prove herself in a bodybuilding competition. As Hyeon-joong supports both women, emotional bonds deepen—especially when Mi-ran comforts a drunk Hyeon-joong. Rosa overcomes injury and self-doubt to compete, rekindling her confidence. The episode ends with a shocking twist as a child appears at the gym, calling Hyeon-joong “Daddy.”

Entries.Title: Beyond the Bar
Entries.Description: Despite a rocky start at Yullim Law Firm, Kang Hyo-min joins Yoon Seok-hoon's team — and impresses him when she finds a discrepancy in their first case.

Episodes.Title: Induction
Episodes.Description: Despite a rocky start at Yullim Law Firm, Kang Hyo-min joins Yoon Seok-hoon's team — and impresses him when she finds a discrepancy in their first case.

Episodes.Title: Hot Water Is the Test for Tea and Love
Episodes.Description: Seok-hoon and Hyo-min take on a case involving a man who broke into a fertility clinic — earning trust in a tangled battle of love, health and injustice.

Episodes.Title: Butterfly Chrysalis
Episodes.Description: A complex no-contact car accident involving a child sends Seok-hoon and Hyo-min digging for clues. Seok-hoon receives a bold offer from Yullim's founder.

Episodes.Title: Lex Talionis
Episodes.Description: While defending a CEO accused of child abuse, Hyo-min and Seok-hoon clash over their morals. Soon, Seok-hoon's sudden disappearance worries her.

Episodes.Title: Salieri's Monologue
Episodes.Description: Hyo-min takes on her first solo case over a painting's copyright, leaning on Seok-hoon for mentorship — until a mid-trial revelation shakes her stride.

Episodes.Title: Love Is an Impairment
Episodes.Description: Seok-hoon and Hyo-min handle a tricky consent case for a client suing her ex. Meanwhile, Kwon Na-yeon's sudden appointment creates waves at Yullim.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: After a man is arrested for aiding his wife's assisted suicide, Seok-hoon takes on the case. Meanwhile, Yullim's new performance system sparks fury.

Episodes.Title: Wonder Woman
Episodes.Description: At Yullim, Ko Tae-seop's plot to oust Seok-hoon escalates. When a famous news anchor is charged with assaulting her husband, Hyo-min digs for the truth.

Episodes.Title: The Right to Life
Episodes.Description: Seok-hoon and Hyo-min defend a doctor who faces possible murder charges for failing to save a man she abhors. Meanwhile, Na-yeon looks into a shady deal.

Episodes.Title: Bystander
Episodes.Description: After a murder suspect blames her for the crime, Hyo-min hunts for their connection. Na-yeon and Seok-hoon pursue the truth behind Yullim's CEO's ploy.

Entries.Title: The Haunted Palace
Entries.Description: Yeo Ri tries to escape the shadow of Kang Cheol, the dragon deity who ruined her past. A request from Yun Gap leads her onto a dangerous path where he is lethally ambushed by political foes, giving Kang Cheol the perfect chance to possess his body. Now, her greatest enemy is closer than ever within the form of her trusted, dying friend.

Episodes.Title: A Talented Woman
Episodes.Description: Yeo Ri tries to escape the shadow of Kang Cheol, the dragon deity who ruined her past. A request from Yun Gap leads her onto a dangerous path where he is lethally ambushed by political foes, giving Kang Cheol the perfect chance to possess his body. Now, her greatest enemy is closer than ever within the form of her trusted, dying friend.

Episodes.Title: Where Gang-Chul Walks, Autumn Turns to Spring
Episodes.Description: Yeo Ri wakes up at the palace. She finds out that Kang Cheol wasn’t the one who attacked Yun Gap. However, she’s still suspicious about Kang Cheol since he possessed Yun Gap’s body. She looks for Yun Gap’s spirit, but she runs into something else instead. Meanwhile, Kang Cheol who is in Yun Gap’s body is fascinated by the human senses. It feels awkward, but he starts to enjoy being human.

Episodes.Title: The Eight-feet Spirit
Episodes.Description: Yeo Ri tries to find Yun Gap, thinking his soul is trapped somewhere in the palace. Kang Cheol tells her that Yun Gap is already taken by the Eight-feet spirit, but Yeo Ri can’t give up on him. She decides to lure the Eight-feet spirit by becoming the bait to save Yun Gap. When she was about to trap the Eight-feet spirit, the king and his men appeared.

Episodes.Title: The Shining Gem of the Night
Episodes.Description: The king is possessed by the Eight-feet Spirit, but Yeo Ri and Kang Cheol manage to get rid of it. Kang Cheol wants to leave the capital to stay away from the Eight-feet Spirit, but Yeo Ri asks him to help her get rid of the spirit and save Yun Gap. However, the king banishes the two from the capital for breaking the law, which is doing a ritual in the capital. Meanwhile, the Eight-feet Spirit finds another target.

Episodes.Title: There Is Someone Helping Eight-Feet Spirit
Episodes.Description: Cheol asks Monk Ga Seop if he could perform gubyeongsisik and drive the Eight-Feet Spirit out of the world. The monk tells him that they need to deplete the energy of the glowing pearl within his body to settle the resentment of the evil spirit. After Prince Yeong In’s passing, Cheol finds out someone in the Palace is aiding the Eight-Feet Spirit.

Episodes.Title: The Skull in the Pillow
Episodes.Description: Pung San is pleased to find out that the Queen is pregnant with the King’s child, giving the General of Heaven and Earth another child to feed on. Cheol learns from Bi Bi that he needs to kill the body of Gap to get out of his body. Meanwhile, Yeo Ri finds a skull with a talisman hidden in the Queen’s pillow that causes the Queen to have nightmares.

Episodes.Title: A Deadly Spell
Episodes.Description: The water spirit attacks Yeo Ri with a deadly spell. She slowly shows the same symptoms as the Queen, who is bedridden due to an unknown illness. Kang Cheol suggests that the King become bait to catch the water spirit, as it wants the royal blood. Yeo Ri hears the news and rushes to the river where Kang Cheol and the King are waiting for the water spirit to emerge.

Episodes.Title: Aguji
Episodes.Description: Yeo Ri and Kang Cheol grant the water spirit’s wish and bring his remains to his daughter. In return, the water spirit confesses that Aguji was behind the attacks on the Queen. The King locks up all the blind shamans from the Bureau of the Blind and interrogates them to find who Aguji is. Meanwhile, Yeo Ri finds out that the Eight-feet Spirit killed her grandmother.

Entries.Title: Bon Appétit, Your Majesty
Entries.Description: After winning a French cooking competition, Yeon Ji-young time-travels through an old cookbook and clashes with King Yi Heon upon arrival.

Episodes.Title: Course Nº 1 Gochujang Butter Bibimbap
Episodes.Description: After winning a French cooking competition, Yeon Ji-young time-travels through an old cookbook and clashes with King Yi Heon upon arrival.

Episodes.Title: Course N° 2 Sous Vide Cuisine
Episodes.Description: Held captive in harsh conditions, Ji-young prepares a feast to win her freedom — but even her talent can't save her when a crisis puts her life in peril.

Episodes.Title: Course N° 3 Haute Cuisine
Episodes.Description: Ji-young becomes Yi Heon's new chief royal cook after impressing him with her French cuisine. But Kang Mok-ju, consumed by jealousy, plots against her.

Episodes.Title: Course N° 4 **** and Spinach Doenjang Soup
Episodes.Description: A high-stakes royal cooking competition awaits Ji-young and her fate at court hangs in the balance. Later, a troubled Yi Heon drunkenly summons her.

Entries.Title: Study Group
Entries.Description: Ga-min is passionate about studying and puts all his efforts into it. However, he never received a good grade, which made him go to Yusung Technical High School. The school is known as a gangster training school, and unlike Ga-min, not many students are into studying. However, Ga-min wants to try a new method of studying, which is forming a study group. He asks his classmate Se-hyun to join him, but he tells Ga-min about a problem he has.

Episodes.Title: Study Group
Episodes.Description: Ga-min is passionate about studying and puts all his efforts into it. However, he never received a good grade, which made him go to Yusung Technical High School. The school is known as a gangster training school, and unlike Ga-min, not many students are into studying. However, Ga-min wants to try a new method of studying, which is forming a study group. He asks his classmate Se-hyun to join him, but he tells Ga-min about a problem he has.

Episodes.Title: The School Inspector
Episodes.Description: Ga-min gets into an unexpected fight against Hyeon U, a school bully. As the fight goes on, the two become the center of attention of everyone in school. At that moment, a man enters the classroom that has become a mess because of the two, and it turns out that he is a school inspector. The vice-principal who got furious about the incident decides to expel Ga-min from school.

Episodes.Title: A New Member
Episodes.Description: Someone applied to the study group. Ga Min is excited to meet the applicant, but it turns out that it is Ji U, Hyeon U’s twin sister. Kyu Jin, a member of the student council, picks on Ji U, and Ga Min confronts him. Han Wul tells Hyeon U about Kyu Jin who was blackmailing Ji U. Meanwhile, Ranked 1 among the 1st years comes to see Ga Min.

Episodes.Title: Teach Me How to Fight
Episodes.Description: Jun is impressed by Ga Min who defeated the rankers. He applies to join the study group and asks Ga Min to teach him how to fight. However, Ga Min rejects him because he only wants students who actually want to study in the study group. Jun decides to join the gang to become stronger, but it only gets him in trouble. Ga Min and his friends go to rescue him.

Episodes.Title: A Real Loser
Episodes.Description: The study group is finally complete. But the school’s top student, Kim Ho Min bullies Se Hyun, who grew up in the same neighbourhood. He tramples on Se Hyun’s pride and beats him up, calling him a poor loser. Ga Min steps up to help him, but it only makes Se Hyun feel like a real loser. After refusing to go to Ga Min’s house, Se Hyun wanders around and ends up running into Ho Min.

Episodes.Title: Ga Min’s Transfer
Episodes.Description: Ga Min breaks the curfew that he promised because of Se Hyun, and his mom tries to transfer him to another school. Han Kyeong and the study group, who can’t give up on Ga Min, persistently chase after Ga Min’s mom and try to persuade her. But that’s when the reserves of the Yeonbaek Gang barge in after finding out about Han Kyeong’s plan for Pi Han Wul.

Episodes.Title: Kim Sun Cheol Going to Prison
Episodes.Description: Ga Min runs into Pi Han Ul’s bodyguard, Kim Sun Cheol, at the hospital where his mother is hospitalized. Sun Cheol was working for Pi Han Ul because he needed to take care of his sick grandfather. In order to pay his grandfather’s hospital bills, Kim Sun Cheol decides to go to prison on the false charge of murder instead of Yeonbaek Gang. Ga Min finds out and steps forward to help Sun Cheol with his friends.

Episodes.Title: Midterm Exam
Episodes.Description: The Study Group sneaks into the Reserves General Meeting and struggles against the Yeonbaek Gang. Pi Han Ul forces Kim Sun Cheol to make a false confession to Detective Na Tae Man. Meanwhile, the fated midterm exam finally begins. The Study Group must improve their grades and climb up at least ten places to hold a disciplinary committee against Pi Han Ul. Will they all succeed?

Entries.Title: Melo Movie
Entries.Description: In love with all things cinema, Ko Gyeom attends an audition, where he meets Kim Mubee. As he slowly develops feelings for her, he tries to get closer.

Episodes.Title: It Will Become Scenic When Dawn Comes
Episodes.Description: In love with all things cinema, Ko Gyeom attends an audition, where he meets Kim Mubee. As he slowly develops feelings for her, he tries to get closer.

Episodes.Title: Why So Serious
Episodes.Description: Five years after vanishing, Gyeom reappears as a critic before Mubee, now a director. But his nonchalant attitude stirs complicated feelings in her.

Episodes.Title: Keep Your Friends Close, But Your Enemies Closer
Episodes.Description: Living in close proximity, Mubee and Gyeom become obsessed with each others' every move. Hong Si-jun and Son Ju-a struggle to reconcile their past.

Episodes.Title: It's Not Your Fault
Episodes.Description: After Mubee and Ju-a partner on a new movie, Ju-a seeks Si-jun's help for the film's music. Gyeom faces a dark consequence from one of his reviews.

Episodes.Title: No One Can Prepare You for the Love and the Fear
Episodes.Description: Gyeom's confession preoccupies Mubee, even though she tries to ignore it. Meanwhile, Ju-a keeps visiting Si-jun, hoping he'll compose the film's music.

Episodes.Title: Happy Ending Is Mine!
Episodes.Description: Mubee gives in to Gyeom's persistence — until he fails to show up one night. Si-jun and Ju-a become trapped together, leading to a frank exchange.

Episodes.Title: Thanks for the Adventure Now Go Have a New One
Episodes.Description: Ko Jun tries to hide a big secret, sparking Gyeom's suspicions. Ju-a and Si-jun reflect on the past — and where they went wrong.

Episodes.Title: All You Need Is Love
Episodes.Description: As Gyeom pretends to be okay, his loved ones worry for his well-being. But soon, Mubee helps him find the courage to confront his feelings.

Episodes.Title: We Were Like Strangers Who Knew Each Other Very Well
Episodes.Description: Si-jun and Ju-a wrestle with their emotions as they question their future. Meanwhile, Mubee's film encounters a hurdle, leaving her feeling at a loss.

Episodes.Title: Life Is a Beautiful, Magnificent Thing, Even to a Jellyfish
Episodes.Description: Shedding their past, Mubee and Gyeom resolve to live their life to the fullest. Si-jun and Ju-a make a final decision about their relationship.

Entries.Title: Karma
Entries.Description: As the debtor faces imminent danger from his loan shark, he enlists Jang Gil-ryong for a diabolical task — one that comes at a high and personal cost.

Episodes.Description: As the debtor faces imminent danger from his loan shark, he enlists Jang Gil-ryong for a diabolical task — one that comes at a high and personal cost.

Episodes.Title: The Man Who Disposed of a Body
Episodes.Description: Distracted by Lee Yu-jeong, Glasses gets into a car accident. When he discovers a witness, he panics and tries to erase any trace of his involvement.

Episodes.Title: The Unrighteous
Episodes.Description: After the witness demands more money, Glasses uncovers inconsistencies in the recent accident. The Debtor panics as Gil-ryong demands his due.

Episodes.Title: The Woman Trapped in the Past
Episodes.Description: Caught in the shadows of her past, Lee Ju-yeon is stirred by a name that echoes old memories, pushing her to confront lingering questions.

Episodes.Title: Rewind
Episodes.Description: Prepared with a plan, the Debtor confronts Gil-ryong — but the plot soon devolves into chaos when the Witness sees an opportunity to exploit.

Episodes.Title: Karma
Episodes.Description: The Witness faces unexpected setbacks after thinking he's in the clear. But with Ju-yeon on his trail, can he break free from the relentless karmic cycle?

Entries.Description: After living in a orphanage, Woo Seul-gi transfers to a top-ranking school hoping to find her father - and soon catches the eye of a popular student.

Episodes.Description: After living in a orphanage, Woo Seul-gi transfers to a top-ranking school hoping to find her father - and soon catches the eye of a popular student.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Facing a heartbreaking discovery, Seul-gi struggles to adjust to her demanding schoolwork, while her background makes her a target of bullyng.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Yu Je-i continues to show kindness towards Seul-gi and invites her to her private study space, drawing the two girls closer together.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: A furious Choi Gyung becomes suspicious when Je-i nominates Seul-gi as class monitor. Ju Ye-ri overhears a conversation about Je-i's former seatmate.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: While Seul-gi finds details of her family history on Je-i's phone, Choi Gyung looks into the connection between the two girls'past.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Students take drastic measures to beat the stress of midterms. Choi Gyung shares a discovery with Seul-gi, causing them to question Je-i's intentions.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Ye-ri makes a deal with Je-i's father, Yu Tae-jun, by using his secret against him. Seul-gi worries about a healt checkup following her exams.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Ye-ri steals Seul-gi's father's phone. As she tries to unlock it, the rest of the students head to the school festival.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: An attack at the festival causes panic at the school. Je-i comes to face with a figure from her past as they fight over the stolen cellphone.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: As the police investigate the school's drug problem, Seul-gi comes under suspicion. Je-i makes a deal while seeking to help Seul-gi.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Struggling to find Yu Je-na, Je-i decides to frame her for dealing, hoping the police will be able to locate her before their father does.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: A traumatic discovery leaves Je-i in a vulnerable state. Feeling uncertain over the situation, a suspicious Seul-gi looks for answers.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: While attending a funeral, Seul-gi suspects foul play. Her search foe evidence leads to a grim connection between her father and Tae-jun.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: With the help of Seul-gi, Je-i uses hidden cameras to spy on her parents, hoping to find a witness who can assist with the court case.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Je-i and Seul-gi take drastic steps when their ranks slide after a big test. Byeong-jin pressures Choi Gyung into taking pills to maintain her grades.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Leading up to the exam, Je-i and Seul-gi craft a final, defiant plan - but there are high risks for everyone involved.

Entries.Title: Anyway Thirty

Episodes.Description: Seo Eun, a stylist nearing thirty, faces personal and professional setbacks, including a breakup and an unexpected connection with Jogging Man.

Episodes.Title: Between Romance and Deception
Episodes.Description: Seo-eun strives to act more mature, but her feelings become complicated when she encounters Jogging Man, a man who stirs up both admiration and jealousy in her.

Episodes.Title: Excitement and Anticipation
Episodes.Description: Seo-eun, returning home for her mother’s 60th birthday, finds herself caught between her parents' conflicting plans while facing pressure about her own marital status.

Episodes.Title: So, Adults
Episodes.Description: Seo-eun navigates emotional turmoil as she lets go of her troubled relationship with Kang-sik, only to sense an unsettling presence following her.

Episodes.Description: Ji Woo's struggling soccer team takes on a new investor who adds a roster of popular influencers to the team.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Team members who need to improve their teamwork skills are invited to a special training camp.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Kang Jae reveals to Ji Woo that they used to be classmates during their school days. Sun Bin is scolded by Tae Young, but the two find time to connect one on one and mend their relationship.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: The captain and Sun Bin train well together, but captain is distracted by Ji Woo and Kyung Jae's interactions, making Sun Bin jealous. Sun Bin schemes behind the scenes to get what he wants.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Kyung Jae and Ji Woo get into a big fight which affects the whole team. They’re forced to take drastic measures to improve their relationship. Likewise, Sun Bin receives difficult training from Tae Young, and sparks fly from their complicated relationship.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: The team has their first practice match and their opponents are made up of previous team members. The match leads to a storm of coverage on the internet. Kyung Jae gets closer and closer to Ji Woo but starts to feel the passion affect him, but a new player Si Woo may bring about a change.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Kyung Jae’s past with Si Woo comes out, which causes Ji Woo to worry. However, Ji Woo regains his confidence and scores a critical goal, which leads to him “kissing” Kyung Jae, leading to uproar on the internet.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Kyung Jae finally confesses his feelings and he and Ji Woo become an item. However, when dirt on Si Woo gets exposed on the internet and causes the team to panic, Kyung Jae makes a huge decision to protect the team and his partner.

Episodes.Description: Sensing trouble, Gwanseok rushes to Muan. After Professor Kim’s boat sinks, Gwanseok, Heedong, Jungsook and others fight over the remaining treasure.

Entries.Title: Our Golden Days
Entries.Description: Ji Hyuk's family has no idea he's committed to staying single for life, and his parents keep pressuring him to settle down and get married. Meanwhile, Eun Oh, an interior designer and Ji Hyuk's former college classmate, has been secretly harbouring feelings for him for years. Eventually, Ji Hyuk musters the courage to tell his parents the truth and announces he's moving out.

Episodes.Title: The Announcement
Episodes.Description: Ji Hyuk's family has no idea he's committed to staying single for life, and his parents keep pressuring him to settle down and get married. Meanwhile, Eun Oh, an interior designer and Ji Hyuk's former college classmate, has been secretly harbouring feelings for him for years. Eventually, Ji Hyuk musters the courage to tell his parents the truth and announces he's moving out.

Episodes.Title: Saying It Right
Episodes.Description: Despite his parents' objections, Ji Hyuk signs a lease and prepares to move out. When Eun Oh hears from Seong Jae that Ji Hyuk has broken up with his girlfriend, she becomes both excited and nervous about how to confess her feelings. Meanwhile, Sang Cheol receives unexpected news that the advisor position he was offered has been cancelled.

Episodes.Title: Trying To Keep It Together
Episodes.Description: After Ji Hyuk rejects her, Eun Oh is emotionally shaken but does her best to stay composed. At the same time, Ji Hyuk feels lost and betrayed when his mentee, a known troublemaker on the team, is suddenly promoted thanks to connections in the company. Overwhelmed by frustration, Ji Hyuk submits his resignation in the heat of the moment.

Episodes.Title: Crossing Paths, Facing Decisions
Episodes.Description: Sang Cheol and his two sons all lost their jobs at the same time, forcing them to search for new opportunities. Eun Oh reencounters Seong Hui when she unexpectedly appears at Cafe Agit. Meanwhile, Ji Hyuk wrestles with inner turmoil after Bo A's shocking proposal.

Episodes.Title: Out Of The Blue
Episodes.Description: The family is stunned by Ji Hyuk's sudden announcement that he's getting married, but despite their shock, they agree to meet his bride-to-be and her family. Seong Jae is equally blindsided when he receives Ji Hyuk's wedding invitation. Meanwhile, Seong Hui offers Eun Oh a large sum of money for a high-stakes interior design project.

Episodes.Title: When Everything Falls Apart
Episodes.Description: After a heated argument with his father, Sang Cheol, Ji Hyuk packs his things and leaves. To Ok Rye, who is extremely worried about Ji Hyuk, Sang Cheol says she should forget about him and consider Ji Wan her eldest grandson from now on. Meanwhile, Seong Jae tries to comfort Eun Oh, who is deeply disappointed in Ji Hyuk.

Episodes.Title: Lost And Unfound
Episodes.Description: The family's anxiety grows when Ji Hyuk's phone number is disconnected. Heartbroken, Eun Oh throws away anything that reminds her of Ji Hyuk. Meanwhile, Sang Cheol's struggle to find work further damages his fragile self-esteem. Far from home, Ji Hyuk begins rediscovering a version of himself he'd long forgotten while fleeing his reality.

Episodes.Title: Under One Roof
Episodes.Description: Eun Oh is shocked to see Ji Hyuk return, acting like a completely different person. Out of the blue, he announces he's starting his own business and sets up an office in the cafe's storage room. As he settles in, he and Eun Oh constantly bicker over even the smallest things, testing her patience each day.

Entries.Title: Undercover High School
Entries.Description: After a botched operation puts Hae-sung and his team in serious jeopardy, the only way for him to salvage his career at the NIS is to accept an assignment that seems almost hard to believe. Hae-sung and his team must infiltrate Byeongmun High School, one of Korea's most elite private institutions, to recover ten tons of gold bars worth a staggering 80 million dollars. With everything on the line, Hae-sung puts on a school uniform, and "Operation Undercover High School" begins.

Episodes.Title: The Emperor's Lost Gold
Episodes.Description: After a botched operation puts Hae-sung and his team in serious jeopardy, the only way for him to salvage his career at the NIS is to accept an assignment that seems almost hard to believe. Hae-sung and his team must infiltrate Byeongmun High School, one of Korea's most elite private institutions, to recover ten tons of gold bars worth a staggering 80 million dollars. With everything on the line, Hae-sung puts on a school uniform, and "Operation Undercover High School" begins.

Episodes.Title: Spooky Stories
Episodes.Description: Hae-sung comes dangerously close to blowing his cover while searching for the hidden gold in Byeongmun High School's eerie old building, barely escaping detection by Soo-ah, his sharp-eyed homeroom teacher. As he hears chilling rumors and faces tight security surrounding the building, he believes that's where he'll find the gold. While dealing with school bullies, Hae-sung begins plotting his next move to uncover the dark secrets lurking inside the old building.

Episodes.Title: Ghost Story Riddles
Episodes.Description: Hae-sung uncovers a crucial clue hidden within the old building, but Chairwoman Seo quickly learns its potential connection to the elusive gold bars. Sensing the connection, she keeps Hae-sung under close watch. Meanwhile, as Hae-sung delves deeper into the ghost stories surrounding the school, he finds himself caught in the escalating tension between Tae-soo and Dong-min, whose conflict ignites chaos throughout the school.

Episodes.Title: Joining the Student Council
Episodes.Description: Hae-sung attends the anti-bullying committee session with a key witness who clears his name, while Dong-min finally finds the courage to stand up for himself. With his name vindicated, Hae-sung uncovers the existence of another grandfather clock hidden in the student council room, and the only way to get closer to it is by joining the student council. With the help of his team, he tries to meet the strict requirements.

Episodes.Title: Student Council
Episodes.Description: Hae Seong and the team grow increasingly concerned that Su A's suspicions could threaten his undercover mission. However, Hae Seong defies the odds and successfully gains a spot in the student council. With this new role, his focus shifts to unraveling the mystery behind the old clocks. Meanwhile, a shadowy figure emerges, threatening to expose Hae Seong's true identity

Episodes.Title: Hye Seong's Father's Notebook
Episodes.Description: The school's security guard dies, leaving Hae Seong a notebook belonging to his missing father. The revelation is shocking, and he storms the NIS for answers. The answer pushes him away from the mission, and he takes time off. However, he resolves to continue but returns only to discover Su A witnessed it all

Episodes.Title: The 24th Anniversary of Byeongmun High School
Episodes.Description: Hae Seong is caught off guard when he recognises Su A's childhood name, Bong Ja, which stirs memories of his first love and distracts him from his focus. Despite the emotional turmoil, Hae Seong pushes forward with the mission to uncover the secrets behind the third ghost story. However, a missing key component forces Su A to join the mission despite Hae Seong's strong opposition to her involvement

Episodes.Title: The Plan for VIP Students
Episodes.Description: After uncovering the possibility of a mole within the NIS, Hae Seong becomes increasingly distrustful of those around him, causing him to question the mission's integrity. Meanwhile, Su A exposes a secretive scheme within the school that guarantees top grades for VIP students. As the web of secrets deepens, Hae Seong uncovers the connection between the gold bars and Chairwoman Seo, prompting him to vow to end her sinister plans

Episodes.Title: The Mathematics Teacher
Episodes.Description: As Su A recovers in the hospital following the attack during the break-in, Hae Seong and the team uncover the culprit: Lee Jun Ho, the mathematics teacher. When Hae Seong detects his father's notebook missing, he realizes that Seo Myeong Ju orchestrated the break-in. After Lee Jun Ho's arrest and confession, the revelation of the school's grade-rigging scandal throws the institution into chaos. Amid the turmoil, Hae Seong stumbles upon a crucial clue to the final scary story.

Episodes.Title: Retribution
Episodes.Description: To everyone's shock, Seo Myeong Ju returns to the school. Unimpressed by Hae Seong, she expels him and demonstrates her power by dismantling his team. However, refusing to back down, Hae Seong and the team, including Su A and her mother, devise a daring plan to infiltrate the school once more to retrieve the hidden gold bars

Episodes.Title: The Devastating Truth
Episodes.Description: The gold bars vanish just as they are within reach, and Seo Myeong Ju suspects Hae Seong has them. In the vault, Hae Seong makes a heartbreaking discovery of his father's remains. Overcome with grief, he finally finds closure, but a shocking truth emerges. He learns Director Kim Hyung Bae was behind it all. Determined to uncover the whole story, Hae Seong heads to confront him alone.

Episodes.Title: Where The Stars Lead
Episodes.Description: Despite getting badly injured, Hae Seong manages to call Su A and his team. They conclude that the only evidence they can secure is the flash drive that contains the voice recording of Principal Park murdering Director Kim Hyung Bae. After finding out that an arrest warrant had been issued for her, Seo Myeong Ju decides to take a special measure to end everything.

He follows her to her home without realizing it and sees how she's still suffering from the curse she's rumoured to have. Dong-jin decides to find out the law of the curse so he can help lift it and save Mi-jung.

He writes a statistics report to prove Park Mi-jung is not a witch, gaining the professor's attention. Dong-jin returns home during school break but learns the villagers have ousted Mi-jung from the village, breaking his heart. After graduating, he gets a job with Shine Solutions and becomes successful.

Episodes.Description: The statistics report Dong-jin wrote returns to him after his mother's death, and a battle within himself begins. He takes time off work and finds a place to live next to Mi-jung to get closer. Meanwhile, a victim of Dong-jin's work comes to get his vengeance, which makes him realize numbers aren't the answers to everything. Afterward, he returns to his hometown to find clues that will break Mi-jung's witch's curse.

Episodes.Title: The Law of Death
Episodes.Description: Dong-jin returns to Taebaek in search of a clue that could break the witch’s curse on Mi-jung. With the support of his friends, he meticulously compiles information about the string of accidents and uncovers a disturbing pattern. As he digs deeper, he realises that he meets every condition of his hypothesis, leaving him filled with suspicion and uncertainty.

Episodes.Title: Means and Methods
Episodes.Description: To uncover the missing years in his investigation, Dong-jin reaches out to Eun-sil, the one person who has been close to Mi-jung since their university days. With her help, he uncovers more accidents and deaths tied to her, strengthening his theory. As the puzzle pieces fall into place, Dong-jin realises the only way truly to validate his findings is to put himself to the ultimate test.

Episodes.Title: Data Validation
Episodes.Description: Dong-jin takes on a delivery job at the supermarket where Mi-jung regularly shops. Every Tuesday, as he delivers her orders, he begins to test the theory he's been developing about her. Gradually, he pushes the boundaries of his own rules, discovering just how dangerous it can be to remain within a ten-meter radius of her. Yet, despite the growing risks, his deepening desire to be closer to her and to linger in her presence threatens to draw him into ever greater peril.

Episodes.Title: Lee Dong Jin
Episodes.Description: Aware of the dire consequences of getting too close for too long, Dong-jin plunges into the river in a desperate attempt to save himself. However, Mi-jung recognises him, intensifying the danger he's already in. As he recovers in the hospital, Dong-jin turns to Producer Heo, seeking her help to identify a key variable in his hypothesis that might hold the solution he is desperately searching for.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: The team is astonished to learn that Na-rae, who joins the task force as a special advisor quant and a senior managing director at Plus General Insurance, is also Ki-jun’s ex-ex-ex-wife, though the two seem surprisingly unfazed. As the team pairs up to gather data for the divorce insurance policy, Ki-jun takes Han-deul to an unexpected place seemingly unrelated to their research.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: The team works tirelessly, fully dedicated to developing a divorce insurance policy. After much effort, the team finally secures conditional approval. But to everyone’s dismay, Ki-jun leads them to a wedding fair to meet their subscriber target. However, Han-deul suddenly cancels all sign-ups at the fair, abruptly halting the plan for reasons unknown.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: When Han-deul bumps into Ki-jun, weary from a run-in with his former brother-in-law, they begin to understand each other's demons of the past. Meanwhile, Na-rae and Jeon-man click and spark a mutual attraction, and Ah-young meets dancer and farmer Woong-sik on a blind date. However, as the task force gains momentum, they face a new challenge— rising divorce rates among their clientele.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Ki-jun and Han-deul rush to resolve a complaint that their divorce insurance subscription event violates industry regulations. Meanwhile, a policyholder couple's decision to get a divorce breaches both industry regulations and company conditions. The task force scrambles to locate the couple, only to discover that the husband, who holds the key to saving the divorce insurance, is missing.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Ki-jun and Han-deul get lost searching for Hyeon-jae when a looming shadow sparks fear—could the rumored tiger be real? They find Hyeon-jae just in time and escape. Upon reuniting with the team, they notice Mi-rae has come for Hyeon-jae but keeps her distance. With village head Woong-sik’s help, they find lodging and work to mend the couple’s rift while reflecting on their past and future.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: "Would you like to live at my place?" In an effort to make Han-deul feel more comfortable, Ki-jun suggests they swap homes. Thanks to his thoughtful gesture, she gradually regains her self-esteem. However, when an elderly couple files for divorce, the divorce insurance faces a new challenge, sparking a heated debate within the team over the implications of late-life divorce.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Ki-jun and Han-deul have no choice but to explain their situation when Na-rae and Jeon-man catch them living in each other's homes. Meanwhile, evidence of Young-kyu's affair comes to light, voiding his divorce insurance subscription. This development helps the project avoid another crisis. However, for some reason, Han-deul suddenly tries to dissuade Seon-hee from proceeding with her divorce.

Entries.Title: The Defects
Entries.Description: Ahyeon and the children, who live as if they were dead after being abandoned, repeat harsh training to protect themselves. Taesik, who has been rescuing children without the organization knowing, makes a decision to save the new 'recall' target.

Episodes.Description: Ahyeon and the children, who live as if they were dead after being abandoned, repeat harsh training to protect themselves. Taesik, who has been rescuing children without the organization knowing, makes a decision to save the new 'recall' target.

Episodes.Description: Ah-hyun and the kids try to run away as Tae-sik has planned for them. However, Jung-hyun, who had been keeping an eye on them, picks up their trail, putting them in danger. As the truth behind the brutal "refund" system comes to light, the kids vow to take revenge on the adults. Their first target is So-mi's adoptive parents.

Episodes.Title: Survivors
Episodes.Description: After being disowned by their adoptive parents, Ah-hyun and the kids live as if they are dead. They endure brutal training, determined to protect themselves. Meanwhile, Tae-sik, who has been secretly rescuing children from the malicious organization, makes a bold decision to save a new "refund" target.

Episodes.Title: Mom
Episodes.Description: To put an end to the inhuman adoption and refund system, Ah-hyun and the kids set out on a daring mission to confront the head of the evil organization. With fierce determination and a carefully crafted plan, they infiltrate the organization's bunker to strike from within. But once inside, Ah-hyun uncovers a devastating truth behind the system.

Episodes.Title: Useful Child
Episodes.Description: The kids risk their lives to save their guardian, Ah-hyun. To do so, they're in desperate need big money, forcing them to confront Ju-an's adoptive father. Their plan is to steal offerings from his church. Meanwhile, Se-hee's ambition to seize even greater power pushes her toward devastating choices that could change the world.

Episodes.Title: Real Name
Episodes.Description: Framed for murder, Ah-hyun and the kids turn to the only adult they trust, Detective Choi. Meanwhile, the unexpected and unwanted return of of Seok-su, the adoptive son who was believed to be dead, throws Kwon Kang-man into a crisis, leading him to seek ways to put an end to the adoption on his own.

Episodes.Title: D-Day
Episodes.Description: The kids barely make it out alive from the fire, but with a tragic loss. Fueled by grief and rage, they vow revenge against the monster once more. Meanwhile, Kim Se-hee sets her sights on a refund project that is far more massive, ruthless, and shocking than Ah-hyun and the kids could have ever imagined.

Episodes.Title: Final Refund
Episodes.Description: What begins as a camping trip soon turns into a living nightmare. Kim Se-hee's inhumanity reaches its peak as she executes her plan to massacre the "defects." To stop her once and for all, Ah-hyun and the kids rise up against her and her team, risking their lives for all the lives to avenge the ones already lost and protect those who could be next.

Entries.Title: Something's Not Right
Entries.Description: Do Bawoo, quiet and well-mannered, once confessed his feelings to his popular and outgoing friend Ji Hoon. But his emotions weren’t fully understood, and Ji Hoon only remembers it as something between friends. Now in college, the two remain close, but Bawoo is gradually growing tired of their ambiguous relationship.

Episodes.Title: A Goodbye Confession
Episodes.Description: Do Bawoo, quiet and well-mannered, once confessed his feelings to his popular and outgoing friend Ji Hoon. But his emotions weren’t fully understood, and Ji Hoon only remembers it as something between friends. Now in college, the two remain close, but Bawoo is gradually growing tired of their ambiguous relationship.

Episodes.Title: Misunderstanding and Prejudice
Episodes.Description: In a whirlwind of emotions, Bawoo proposes to Hoon, 'Let's date for just one week.' Hoon, seemingly in disbelief, replies, 'Okay.' However, Bawoo becomes even more confused by his reaction and gradually feels hurt by Hoon’s attitude, which doesn’t seem to take the proposal seriously.

Episodes.Title: It’s Okay, Even If You Don’t Mean It
Episodes.Description: Bawoo agrees to work on a webtoon project with Hamin, and the two begin working together. Meanwhile, Hun misunderstands their relationship as a "stalking situation" and starts to keep Hamin in check. Hun expresses excessive affection toward Bawoo, while Hamin sincerely approaches him. Caught between the two, Bawoo becomes emotionally confused and tries to sort out his feelings through writing, but the situation only grows more complicated.

Episodes.Title: Something Started to Go Wrong
Episodes.Description: As Bawoo is about to grow closer to Hoon at his house, Hoon suddenly wakes up and catches Bawoo off guard, prompting him to leave in a panic. Later, Hun misunderstands Bawoo’s confession as a fake one made just to push Hamin away, and brushes it off with a casual “Thanks.” Hurt by this, Bawoo becomes increasingly cold toward Hoon and eventually tries to end things, saying, “That talk about dating was nonsense.”

Episodes.Title: I Thought You’d Like It
Episodes.Description: Hoon looks at a guitar pick Bawoo once gave him and recalls old memories. Bawoo is emotionally stirred by Hoon’s cryptic comment, “There are only three days left,” and grows closer to Hamin in the meantime. Then, Hoon lies about being sick to get Bawoo to meet him. He tries to lighten the mood with a playful attitude, but Bawoo asks, “Don’t you think something’s gone wrong between us?” as he tries to sort out his feelings.

Episodes.Title: After All This Time, I Finally Reached You… Part 1
Episodes.Description: Swayed by Hoon's false message, Bawoo agrees to meet him again, but he tries to keep his distance, determined to end his lingering feelings. Hamin comforts Bawoo through his emotional turmoil and stays by his side, bringing them closer. Meanwhile, Hoon reflects on the past and realizes the sincerity of Bawoo's confession after coming across a note he had written.

Episodes.Title: After All This Time, I Finally Reached You… Part 2
Episodes.Description: Hoon finally confesses his feelings to Bawoo, but Bawoo believes it comes from pity and guilt, so he refuses to accept it. Hamin realizes his own feelings for Bawoo, but upon noticing that Bawoo’s heart still leans toward Hoon, he quietly steps back. Although Bawoo and Hoon eventually share their true feelings, the emotions that arrive too late only deepen the conflict. Bawoo decides to put an end to it, saying, 'Let’s stop here.'

Episodes.Title: Nothing’s Going Wrong
Episodes.Description: Bawoo ultimately rejects Hoon’s confession and tries to end their relationship, but Hoon refuses to give up and leaves his heartfelt message in a notebook. After reading it, Bawoo runs to him and confesses, “No matter how hard I try, I just can’t stop liking you.” Hoon then reveals he’s liked Bawoo since middle school. Finally, they confirm their love for each other and share a kiss.

Entries.Title: Heesu in Class 2
Entries.Description: Hee-soo, a 18-year-long “never-dated” individual, ironically happens to be the school's top relationship counselor. Secretly, Hee-soo has been harboring feelings for his best friend of 10 years, Joo Chan-young. With zero chance of success, he had decided not to confess and to nurture his bittersweet unrequited love alone. However, someone anonymously identifying themselves as “Carrot” begins expressing their affection toward Hee-soo. "Could this possibly be Joo Chan-young? Does he like me too?" Hee-soo's mind becomes increasingly complicated by these unknown declarations of love.

Episodes.Description: Seung-won, who secretly loves Hee-soo, devises a fake crush to get closer to him by requesting relationship advice. Meanwhile, Chan-young, who has only been in meaningless relationships, starts developing feelings for Ji-yoo, a girl he meets at the academy. Watching Chan-young's growing interest in Ji-yoo, Hee-soo begins to feel a sense of urgency. Misled by Seung-won’s fake crush, Hee-soo mistakenly believes Seung-won also likes Ji-yoo. This misunderstanding leads Hee-soo to try to bring Seung-won and Ji-yoo together, all while planning to keep Chan-young for himself.

Episodes.Title: Forever and After

Entries.Title: Oh My Ghost Clients
Entries.Description: After a failed cryptocurrency gamble, Mu-jin finds himself jobless, broke, and separated from his wife. Urged by a friend, he studies and passes the labour attorney exam. With no clients and heavy pressure to succeed, he opens a tiny office but still struggles to pay the rent. However, an idea from Hee-ju starts to get the ball rolling.

Episodes.Title: Licensed To Fight
Episodes.Description: After a failed cryptocurrency gamble, Mu-jin finds himself jobless, broke, and separated from his wife. Urged by a friend, he studies and passes the labour attorney exam. With no clients and heavy pressure to succeed, he opens a tiny office but still struggles to pay the rent. However, an idea from Hee-ju starts to get the ball rolling.

Episodes.Title: A Ghost's Grudge
Episodes.Description: After a near-death experience, Mu-jin strikes a strange deal with a mysterious figure named Bo-sal. But in return, he begins to see terrifying ghosts with grudges. Haunted by the spirit of Min-uk, Mu-jin gets pushed to investigate the unsafe factory where Min-uk died. Gyeon-woo goes undercover as a new hire and meets Nimal, a migrant worker afraid to speak out, but as the truth surfaces, the team is exposed and forced into a desperate retreat.

Episodes.Title: Possessed By Vengence
Episodes.Description: To his shock, Mu-jin still encounters vengeful spirits and is even more stunned by the fine print in his six-month contract. His next case involves Cho Eun-young, a nurse consumed by revenge. Not only does she terrify him, but she also takes control of his body, unleashing chaos in the hospital as she hunts down those responsible for her death.

Episodes.Title: Behind Hospital Walls
Episodes.Description: Mu-jin and his team look for evidence to reclassify Nurse Cho Eun-young's suicide as an industrial accident, aiming to hold the hospital accountable for covering up suspected workplace bullying and medical malpractice. However, with Mu-jin blacklisted from the hospital, it falls to Gyeon-woo to infiltrate the facility and locate the one piece of evidence Mu-jin remembers seeing while possessed.

Episodes.Title: The Unjust Test
Episodes.Description: Mu-jin's father suspects his mother of having an affair and asks him to investigate. When Mu-jin visits, he encounters a ghost, a close friend of his mother, seeking justice. Following his mother to her university, Mu-jin uncovers a mysterious test that may explain the ghost's tragic death.

Episodes.Title: Union Power
Episodes.Description: With the protest shut down by police, Mu-jin and the workers regroup to form a union, vowing to fight to the end. However, when the university refuses to meet their demands, they have no choice but to go on strike. Just as the situation begins to look hopeful, they encounter unexpected backlash from students, prompting them to question the very cause for which they have been fighting.

Episodes.Title: Yoon-jae's Collapse
Episodes.Description: Mu-jin encounters the restless spirit of Yoon-jae in a hospital and discovers that Yoon-jae collapsed because of exploitative working conditions at a foreign-owned supermarket. With Yoon-jae in a coma, Mu-jin seeks institutional support and tangible evidence of employer negligence and must also convince Yoon-jae's spirit not to surrender to despair.

Episodes.Title: Factory Fire
Episodes.Description: When things look to be slowing down for Mu-jin and his team, a fire in a factory takes the lives of factory workers who all show up before him looking for help. As Mu-jin uncovers the extent of the factory's willful disregard for fire safety regulations, he realizes that the true source of the negligence lies with a more powerful entity, Myungeum Constructions. Chung-ja visits her niece to fill in the missing pieces of what happened between her and her sister, Baek-ja. After watching Go Hui-yeong at her stardom, Chung-ja becomes determined to reclaim her place.

Episodes.Title: Cosmopolitan

Episodes.Title: Bubble Gum Boy Shot

Episodes.Title: Violet Fizz
Episodes.Description: Yooha ends up spending the night at Minwoo's place. In a home that feels cold yet strangely warm, a quiet curiosity begins to grow between them.

Episodes.Title: Black Russian
Episodes.Description: A sudden call from Minwoo's parents! Yooha unexpectedly shows his sincerity in front of them, and that night, Minwoo finds himself overwhelmed by unfamiliar feelings. Emotions he never planned for are starting to grow.

Episodes.Title: Take Five
Episodes.Description: An unexpected date between Taeha and Jaemin, and Minwoo shows up at a nude croquis class?! Moments that bring everyone a little closer to each other.

Episodes.Title: Earthquake
Episodes.Description: Minwoo's close friend Suyeon asks Yooha to be her pretend boyfriend? Minwoo grows anxious, and Yooha finds himself confused.

Episodes.Title: Scarlett O’Hara
Episodes.Description: Minwoo and Yooha find themselves drifting, each lost in their own thoughts of the other. In the midst of it all, Taeha disappears, leaving Yooha to face the void he left behind. And into that space steps Suyeon, with a tempting offer.

Episodes.Title: Bloody Mary
Episodes.Description: Yooha says goodbye to Minwoo. The new deal comes with better terms, but why does his heart feel heavier than ever?

Episodes.Title: Tequila Sunrise
Episodes.Description: Minwoo admits his love, and Taeha acknowledges his pain. Yooha walks away from a heartless contract-toward where real feelings reside.

Episodes.Title: Blue Sky
Episodes.Description: At last, Yooha and Minwoo reunite, confess their true feelings, and begin building a new future together. Love and dreams-this time, it's all real.

Episodes.Title: The Moon Wanes, Yet the Young Heart Remains

Episodes.Title: Such an Uneven Love
Episodes.Description: While facing a career setback during an economic downturn, Geum-myeong encounters a familiar face — sparking an unexpected new beginning.

Episodes.Title: Spread Your Wings and Fly
Episodes.Description: Ae-sun and Gwan-sik grapple with Yang Eun-myeong's misfortune, sacrificing everything they can to help him. But Eun-myeong's self-confidence takes a hit.

Episodes.Title: A Spring Every Day
Episodes.Description: Between new business ventures and career changes, the family faces separate hurdles on their paths — drawing strength from their bond to press ahead.

Episodes.Title: Here's to All You've Been Through
Episodes.Description: As the Yang family finally enjoys the fruits of their labor, sudden agony strikes — testing their resolve and the strength of their enduring love.

Episodes.Title: This message has been deleted
Episodes.Description: Baek-ho deals devastating news to Mi-kyung, forcing her to figure out her next steps. But later, an emergency forces the two to work together.

Episodes.Title: Person of Interest
Episodes.Description: Baek-ho and Mi-kyung see new sides of each other, and feelings begin to blossom. A new arrival at the guesthouse stirs jealousy in Mi-kyung.

Episodes.Title: False Goat's Beard
Episodes.Description: After a shakeup at the potato lab, Baek-ho and Mi-kyung take a business trip together. But soon after, Baek-ho starts avoiding her, leaving her confused.

Episodes.Description: The sudden appearance of an unwelcome visitor wreaks havoc at the guesthouse. Mi Gyeong later panics out after discovering a secret relationship.

Episodes.Title: MK107

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Daon is a rational and calm person in his company and known for often fighting with his colleague Sunghyeon. One day Daon once again sees Jaemin, the senior he admired in university, along with Suhyeon, the heir to the company, and a relationship emerges between the four…

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: When Daon becomes distracted at work, Sunghyeon proactively notices and starts caring for him. Their relationship starts to become more and more ambiguous.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Suhyeon returns to the company as a department head and asks Daon if he’s still in contact with Jaemin. Jaemin confesses his attraction to Daon, and the entanglement escalates.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: A secret contract is revealed, and Daon is forced to come to terms with past relationships along with new department challenges. After a drunken party, Daon calls a certain man.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: After the drunken night, Sunghyeon gives Daon the cold shoulder, leaving him feeling confused As Daon tries to remember what happened last night, Sunghyeon reminds him they kissed. Meanwhile, his relationship with Jaemin and Suhyeon becomes more tense....

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: When Suhyeon starts interfering with Daon’s work and emotions, Sunghyeon gets triggered and a fight breaks out in the workplace. Meanwhile, Suhyeon reveals that Daon’s sad past may be connected to Jaemin.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: After learning about Jaemin’s past actions, Daon decides to take a stand and tell Sunghyeon how he feels. At the same time, the company is rocked by a scandal, and Daon leaves his job. Just as he tries to get his life together, he gets kidnapped.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Sunghyeon realizes that Daon is missing and tracks him down to where he is held. During the confrontation, Sunghyeon gets injured while trying to protect Daon. While at the hospital, the two finally confess their feelings to each other.

Entries.Title: My Dearest Nemesis
Entries.Description: Su-jeong, 19, has been living a hectic life, taking care of her deceased mother's belongings. She meets her first love, 'Black Flame Dragon', in a game she started by chance. However, her first love, which was full of excitement, ends up being the darkest part of her life... 16 years later, Su-jeong, who has become the team leader of Yongseong Department Store, meets the newly appointed head of the headquarters, Ju-yeon.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1

However, her first love, which was full of excitement, ends up being the darkest part of her life... 16 years later, Su-jeong, who has become the team leader of Yongseong Department Store, meets the newly appointed head of the headquarters, Ju-yeon.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Su-jeong tries to repair her relationship with Ju-yeon, which was wrong from the start, but it is not easy. Su-jeong is just a thorn in Ju-yeon's side, who has a secret he does not want to be found out. Then, Ju-yeon eventually finds out about his private life and the situation changes.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: A large-scale renewal project for Yongseong Department Store is underway, led by Joo-yeon. Joo-yeon and Soo-jeong grow closer as they work together. Joo-yeon's heart also opens up as Soo-jeong begins to understand him. But something happens that disappoints Joo-yeon in Soo-jeong.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Eventually, the 'Secret Room' opens. Soo-jung suddenly receives help from Joo-yeon. Joo-yeon's new appearance makes her laugh... Meanwhile, Shin-won does something he's never done before because of Ha-jin.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Ha-jin witnesses Su-jeong and Ju-yeon together. They must be separated before they realize each other's identity. Ha-jin's sabotage operation even involves Shin-won! Ju-yeon misunderstands that Su-jeong is interested in Shin-won...

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Why on earth did they kiss? Soo-jung is embarrassed by what happened last night. She believes that Joo-yeon will confess or explain, but Joo-yeon doesn't say anything. Soo-jung, who is upset, decides to go on a blind date with Ha-jin.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Juyeon doesn't hide his feelings for Sujeong. However, Sujeong rejects him due to the 'younger man' trauma. Then Juyeon is about to get caught by Hyoseon.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Soo-jung and Joo-yeon finally confirm each other's feelings, and their thrilling secret love begins. It's a love that must be kept secret from everyone, but they're happy that they can be together... What is this ominous feeling? Meanwhile, Shin-won and Ha-jin have a chance meeting at a wedding hall

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Strawberry and Black Flame Dragon meet again. As past wounds resurface, the conflict between Soo-jeong and Joo-yeon deepens. It seems like this is the end... but to make matters worse, a scandal breaks out between the two.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Joo-yeon is fired. In the end, he is abandoned by Hyo-sun and becomes alone. Soo-jeong hides the crisis that is in front of her and tries hard for Joo-yeon. Meanwhile, Ha-jin's ex-husband comes to see him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Soo-jeong, who lived alone, shouldering everything in order to be recognized and not be ignored. Joo-yeon, who wanted to be loved by her grandmother even while hiding herself. Can the two of them release their respective seals and be together?

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Su Jang turns down an offer to work in the U.S., choosing to stay with Ju Yan, and they receive their happily-ever-after as they are appointed to key positions at Yongsung Department Store. Ju Yan's grandmother, Chairwoman Jang, apologizes to him for her past behavior, and Hyo Seon also makes peace with Ju Yan, leading to a full reconciliation.

Entries.Title: Ball Boy Tactics

One day, Jiwon spots Jungwoo practicing alone in the empty gymnasium and is unintentionally drawn to him. Later, through a series of misunderstandings, a casual remark changes their relationship forever.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1

One day, Jiwon spots Jungwoo practicing alone in the empty gymnasium and is unintentionally drawn to him. Later, through a series of misunderstandings, a casual remark changes their relationship forever.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Han Jiwon deliberately avoids Kwon Jungwoo, but they keep running into each other and even become group members. After Jungwoo announces his breakup with his girlfriend, the two began to interact more frequently and meaningfully; Jiwon realizes he has fallen in love.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Han Jiwon and Kwon Jungwoo prepare a class report together, and the relationship between the two grows warmer. However, Jiwon receives a confession from a schoolmate, which makes Jungwoo feel jealous and concerned. After a dinner party, Jungwoo takes a walk with Jiwon, and Jiwon gathers the strength to invite Jungwoo home with him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Jungwoo fantasizes about Jiwon despite being ill while rejecting Jiwon’s concern. When he sees a photo of Jiwon with his younger brother, he is overcome with jealousy and finally realizes his feelings. When Jiwon visits him in the dormitory, he makes his move.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Jungwoo's confession makes Jiwon feel that he’s been put in a bind, and is scared how their relationship might l affect their future. He asks for two weeks to think about it, and Jungwoo smiles and says he'll try his best to woo him. Jungwoo comes out in front of his friends, which shakes up Jiwon even more, which eventually leads him to talking about his feelings.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Jiwon's relationship with Jungwoo begins. While sharing a bed, Jiwon has trouble coming to terms with Jungwoo's intimate behavior and his classmates' teasing, leading him to hide his relationship. In the middle of the night, Jiwon confesses his insecurities and fears, while Jungwoo's gentle embrace makes them more courageous to fall in love.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Online gossip alleges that Han Jiwon and Kwon Jungwoo are secretly dating. Won chooses to remain silent and distant in order to protect Jungwoo's career. Meanwhile, Jungwoo is injured during training, and the pressure from his coach and lack of contact with Jiwon causes him to have an emotional breakdown, putting their relationship to the test.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: After an argument, Jiwon and Jungwoo kiss and make up. The next day, Jiwon takes the initiative to disclose his love, and Jungwoo uses the number “18” on the back of his jersey to symbolize the most precious person in his heart in a media interview. They no longer run away from each other and instead choose to love each other openly.
